stories.title: Fossiel van dier uit dinotijd laat zien hoe zoogdieren anders gingen eten

en.title: Fossil of animal from dinosaur era shows how mammals developed different eating methods
en.summary: A 165-million-year-old fossil discovered in China reveals a furry creature with swimming abilities similar to a platypus, hunting skills like an otter, and a beaver-like tail, providing insights into how mammals evolved new feeding strategies.

stories.title: Realityprogramma De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring 2026

en.title: Reality program De Bondgenoten wins Golden Television Ring 2026
en.summary: The reality television program De Bondgenoten received the Golden Television Ring award for 2026.

stories.title: OM had beveiliging van ICT-systemen niet goed op orde, oordeelt commissie

en.title: Public Prosecutor's Office did not properly manage ICT systems security, committee concludes
en.summary: A committee found that the Public Prosecutor's Office failed to adequately organize the security of its information technology systems.

stories.title: Dit zijn alle winnaars van het Gouden Televizier-Ring Gala 2026

en.title: These are all the winners of the Golden Television Ring Gala 2026
en.summary: Multiple awards were presented across various categories at the Golden Television Ring Gala held at the Royal Theatre Carré in Amsterdam, with NU.nl providing a complete list of all winners.

stories.title: Rusland niet langer ‘de agressor’, maar ‘onze vijand’, zegt Yesilgöz

en.title: Russia no longer 'the aggressor', but 'our enemy', says Yesilgöz
en.summary: A Dutch political figure has stated that Russia should no longer be characterized as an aggressor but rather as an enemy, indicating a shift in official terminology regarding the country.

stories.title: Goed bewaard fossiel vertelt hoe zoogdieren anders gingen eten dan de dino's

en.title: Well-preserved fossil shows how mammals ate differently than dinosaurs
en.summary: A 165-million-year-old fossil discovered in China reveals how mammals during the dinosaur era developed a new swallowing method. The specimen is exceptionally preserved, showing skin and fur impressions of a creature resembling a cross between a beaver and a platypus.

stories.title: Vier astronauten na 237 dagen terug op aarde, record voor Europese vrouw

en.title: Four astronauts return to Earth after 237 days, record for European woman
en.summary: Four astronauts returned safely to Earth from the International Space Station after eight months, landing off the coast of Los Angeles via SpaceX capsule. The crew included two Americans, one Russian, and one French astronaut who set a record for a European woman.

stories.title: Gouden Televizier-Ring voor De Bondgenoten, presentator Jan Versteegh wint ook

en.title: Golden Televizier-Ring awarded to De Bondgenoten, presenter Jan Versteegh also wins
en.summary: The SBS6 reality competition series De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring 2026, the Dutch viewer's choice award. Presenter Jan Versteegh also won the award for best presenter, while Annet Malherbe won best actor.

stories.title: Bondgenoten grote winnaar bij Gouden Televizier-Ring, ook Jan Versteegh wint

en.title: Bondgenoten major winner at Golden Televizier-Ring, Jan Versteegh also wins
en.summary: Reality program De Bondgenoten won the Golden Televizier-Ring award. Jan Versteegh won best presenter, Annet Malherbe won best actor, and Daan Alferink won the television talent award.

stories.title: Britse politie: bevel voor huiszoeking bij voormalig prins Andrew was onrechtmatig

en.title: British police: search warrant for former Prince Andrew was unlawful
en.summary: British police arrested King Charles's younger brother in February on suspicion of misconduct in public office. The implications of the unlawful warrant for the ongoing investigation into Mountbatten-Windsor remain unclear.

stories.title: Teruglezen | De Bondgenoten wint Gouden Televizier-Ring, Annet Malherbe beste acteur

en.title: Live coverage | The Allies wins Golden Television Ring, Annet Malherbe best actor
en.summary: The 2026 Golden Television Ring Gala awards ceremony took place, with The Allies winning the main prize and Annet Malherbe receiving the best actor award.

stories.title: Huiszoekingsbevelen voor woningen ex-prins Andrew waren onwettelijk

en.title: Search warrants for residences of ex-Prince Andrew were unlawful
en.summary: Thames Valley Police acknowledged that search warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's residences were unlawful. The acknowledgment does not affect the ongoing criminal investigation into King Charles's brother.
